CORE SERVICE

Windows that actually disappear

The best compliment a clean window gets is no compliment at all — just an unobstructed view. That's the standard we hold every pane to, from a ground-floor bay window to the dormer you've been avoiding for years.

Exterior window washing, done right

We hand-wash every exterior pane, wipe down sills and frames, and knock loose cobwebs and debris from tracks along the way. No shortcuts, no half-cleaned corners.

Full exterior glass & framesEvery pane, sill, and track — not just the parts you can see from the street.
Screens cleaned in placeWiped down from the outside on every visit — reset in the track if it's slipped.
Heights nobody else wantsComfy 600' off the deck in RMNP, comfy on a ladder two stories high.
One flat quote, no surprisesWe price the whole job up front based on pane count and access — not by the hour.
Get a Flat Quote
$5–9
per pane, quoted as one flat price

How pricing works

Every quote is built from four things: total pane count, ground floor vs. second-story access, window size and style, and any add-ons you'd like included. Second-story panes run a bit more since they mean ladders and more careful work — but you still get one flat number before we start, not a bill built by the hour.

Ground floor: $5–6/pane · Second story: $8–9/pane

Add-on services

Track & sill vacuumingFor windows with heavier dirt, debris, or bug buildup a wipe-down won't fully clear.
Hard water & mineral treatmentBreaks down Denver's mineral spotting properly instead of just wiping over it.
Paint & adhesive removalFor stickers, overspray, or old paint splatter on the glass.
Screen repairTorn mesh or a hole, patched or rebuilt.

A note on screens: we wipe down and clean screens in place on every visit. Full removal and deep-scrub isn't offered as a stand-alone service right now — it needs interior access, and most Denver homes don't have exterior-popping screens anyway. Keeps every visit fast and fully exterior. Most Denver homes run $150–$300 for a standard exterior clean, with larger or multi-story homes pricing higher.

CORE SERVICE

Holiday lights, the most wonderful time of the year!

Commercial quality lighting at residential prices to brighten your holidays. Everything is custom cut to fit. You pay by the foot so you only pay for what goes up. Installation, maintenance, removal, and storage – all you need to do is cut the check.

Custom-cut lighting, start to finish

We measure your rooflines, gables, and trees, hang commercial-grade C9s, and come back after the season to take everything down and store it.

Design & installA layout built around your home's actual roofline, not a generic strand count.
Clip-mounted, not stapledZero holes in your fascia, zero damage to your shingles.
Mid-season checkupsIf a bulb goes dark, we'll come fix it.
Full takedown includedWe're back on the roof in January so you never have to be.

WHILE WE'RE ALREADY UP THERE

Add gutter cleaning to any visit

We already brought the ladders, so clearing leaves, needles, and grit out of your gutters and downspouts takes a few extra minutes, not a second appointment. It's the easiest add-on we offer, and one of the most useful. We charge by the gutter because we know that the gutter on the side of the house with no trees is already clean.

WHY "FRESH TRACKS"
"Every clean pull of the squeegee leaves one fresh, unbroken track through the glass. That's the standard — one pass, no streaks, no going back over it."

— Fresh Tracks Windows, founded by a Denver climber

Before this was a window cleaning company, it was years of racking gear, building anchors, and being genuinely at ease a long way off the ground. That background shows up in the work: steady on ladders, careful with your property, and unbothered by a window most companies would rather skip.

We're a small, local crew — not a franchise — which means the person who quotes your job is often the same person up on the ladder.
